debtOf(uint256).notice: Principal, interest and total debt in stablecoin units, as of now.

graceSeconds().notice: Real seconds a hold must outlast the loan term by, so the borrower's own way out         (`reclaimHoldByPartition`, open once the hold expires) never opens while a loan is live.

liquidate(uint256).notice: Permissionless: both triggers are objective and on-chain. After the term it reads NO price, so it         works whatever the feed is doing; before the term it needs a trusted price at or above the         liquidation threshold. The only destination is the one the borrower fixed at pledge time.

openLoan(address,uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: Lender only: it is their cash that moves. One transaction: read the hold, check it, then move         the cash. There is no moment at which the loan exists unsecured.

position(uint256).notice: The loan's state in one call. Never reverts because of the feed: a feed that cannot be read         comes back as `priceUsable == false`, not as a price.

price8().notice: The price per bill in 8 decimals, or the reason it cannot be trusted. Reverts on a zero or         negative answer and on a stale one.

repay(uint256).notice: Borrower only. Pulls principal plus interest, pushes it to the lender and releases the hold.         Either both legs happen or neither does.

topUp(uint256,uint256).notice: Borrower only. Repays part of the principal, which lowers the debt and the LTV. Refused on a         price nobody can stand behind, like any new credit decision.

validateOpen(address,uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Every pre-flight check `openLoan` makes except the lender check and the cash movement.         Reverts with the same error `openLoan` would, so a page can show the refusal before it is sent.
